title: Classification via logistic regression: theory and code

cues.en: Logistic regression is a statistical analysis used for predicting categorical outcomes in a data set.
cues.zh: 邏輯斯迴歸是一種統計分析，用來預測資料集中的類別結果。

cues.en: It's used quite often in machine learning and also in mechanistic interpretability.
cues.zh: 它在機器學習與機制可解釋性中都經常使用。

cues.en: In this lecture, I will introduce you to the idea and interpretation of logistic regression, and I'll
cues.zh: 這堂課會介紹邏輯斯迴歸的概念與解讀方式，

cues.en: also show you the Python code to visualize and implement the analysis.
cues.zh: 也會示範如何以 Python 程式碼將這項分析視覺化並實作。

cues.en: So yeah, you use a logistic regression when the dependent variable, also called the DV, can only take on one of two values like true or false.
cues.zh: 當依變數，也就是 DV，只能取兩種值，例如真或假時，就可以使用邏輯斯迴歸。

cues.en: Alive or dead, win or lose, and so on.
cues.zh: 例如生或死、贏或輸等等。

cues.en: Now these have to be mutually exclusive categories, meaning that both categories cannot be simultaneously true in the same data measurement.
cues.zh: 這些類別必須互斥，也就是在同一次資料測量中，兩個類別不能同時成立。

cues.en: The logistic regression framework can be extended to any number of categorical outcomes, in which case it's generally called a multinomial logistic regression.
cues.zh: 邏輯斯迴歸架構也能擴充到任意數目的類別結果，這時通常稱為多項邏輯斯迴歸。

cues.en: Now this is actually the basis of the loss function when training LMS.
cues.zh: 這其實就是訓練 LLM 時損失函數的基礎。

cues.en: But here in this and the next videos we're just going to be working with binary outcomes.
cues.zh: 不過這支影片與接下來幾支影片只會處理二元結果。

cues.en: So that also simplifies the analysis quite a bit.
cues.zh: 這也能讓分析簡單很多。

cues.en: Now one thing to keep in mind which I will demonstrate in the code, is that logistic regression on its own does not actually classify any data.
cues.zh: 有一點要記住，我會在程式中示範：邏輯斯迴歸本身其實不會將資料分類。

cues.en: What the logistic regression does is calculate the probability that a data point belongs to a particular category.
cues.zh: 它計算的是一個資料點屬於特定類別的機率。

cues.en: You would then take those numerical probability scores and apply some threshold to actually make a category prediction.
cues.zh: 接著再將這些機率分數套用某個門檻，才會真正得到類別預測。

cues.en: So the probability values range from 0 to 1, and you would typically use a value of 0.5 as a threshold
cues.zh: 機率值介於 0 和 1 之間，通常會以 0.5 作為門檻，

cues.en: for prediction.
cues.zh: 用來進行預測。

cues.en: Again, I'll show that in the code in a few moments.
cues.zh: 稍後我會在程式中示範。

cues.en: But first, I want to describe a little bit about the math of a logistic regression.
cues.zh: 不過，我想先稍微說明邏輯斯迴歸的數學。

cues.en: The logistic regression initially looks a little bit like a regular regression, in that we have predictor variables that are the x's in this equation.
cues.zh: 邏輯斯迴歸一開始有點像一般迴歸，方程式中的 x 就是預測變數。

cues.en: And then we have the coefficients.
cues.zh: 然後還有係數。

cues.en: Those are the beta values including a beta zero term which is called the constant or the intercept.
cues.zh: 也就是這些 beta 值，包括稱為常數項或截距的 beta 零。

cues.en: So this is the model of the data on the right hand side.
cues.zh: 右側就是資料的模型。

cues.en: Now in a regular standard regression the left hand side would be the predicted data value, like a test
cues.zh: 在一般的標準迴歸中，左側會是預測的資料值，例如考試

cues.en: score or height, or the price of a house with a logistic regression.
cues.zh: 成績、身高或房價。若使用邏輯斯迴歸，

cues.en: What you actually want to predict is the log of the probability that a data value is in one of the categories.
cues.zh: 真正要預測的則是資料值屬於某個類別的機率之對數。

cues.en: Now, if you're wondering why we use the log of the probabilities and not just the actual probability, then that's a great question and I will answer it soon.
cues.zh: 如果你想問，為什麼要用機率的對數，而不直接用機率，這是個好問題，我很快就會回答。

cues.en: But first I want to show you how this equation gets transformed so that we can actually use the model
cues.zh: 但我想先示範如何轉換這個方程式，讓我們真正能用模型

cues.en: to generate a probability of being in one of the two categories.
cues.zh: 產生屬於兩個類別之一的機率。

cues.en: Essentially, this just involves solving for p the probability of being in one of the categories.
cues.zh: 基本上，就是解出 p，也就是屬於其中一個類別的機率。

cues.en: The first step is to get rid of the natural log, and we do that by taking the natural exponent of both sides of the equation.
cues.zh: 第一步是消掉自然對數，做法是對等號兩邊取自然指數。

cues.en: So then you get e to the all of this stuff up here.
cues.zh: 於是得到 e 的這整串表達式次方。

cues.en: The next step involves isolating p and solving for p.
cues.zh: 接著要將 p 獨立出來，解出 p。

cues.en: Now there is a little bit of algebra that I'm skipping over here, but essentially you end up with one
cues.zh: 這裡省略了一點代數運算，但基本上最後會得到 1

cues.en: over one plus E to the minus all of the regression expression in here.
cues.zh: 除以 1 加上 e 的負的這整串迴歸表達式次方。

cues.en: So this is the form of the logistic equation.
cues.zh: 這就是邏輯斯方程式的形式。

cues.en: And now we need to solve for the betas so that we can apply this equation to each individual data sample and get a probability value.
cues.zh: 現在必須求出 beta，才能將這個方程式套用到每筆資料樣本，取得機率值。

cues.en: And so how do we actually do that.
cues.zh: 那麼，究竟該怎麼做？

cues.en: How do we find the values of the betas that give us the best probabilities that most closely match the predicted categories?
cues.zh: 如何找出一組 beta，讓算出的機率最符合預測的類別？

cues.en: Well, typically a regression analysis is optimally solved using the left inverse algorithm.
cues.zh: 一般來說，迴歸分析可利用左反矩陣演算法求得最佳解。

cues.en: However, that algorithm only works for linear models.
cues.zh: 但是那個演算法只適用於線性模型。

cues.en: And here we have nonlinearities in the coefficients.
cues.zh: 這裡的係數則涉及非線性。

cues.en: So the left inverse method doesn't work, or at least not directly.
cues.zh: 因此左反矩陣的方法行不通，至少不能直接套用。

cues.en: So instead a A solution is to use iterative approximations until you get a good solution.
cues.zh: 所以，一個解法是使用反覆近似，直到得到好的解。

cues.en: There are several ways to do iterative solutions.
cues.zh: 反覆求解有好幾種方式。

cues.en: You can use a local linearization and then apply linear least squares approximations.
cues.zh: 可以進行局部線性化，再套用線性最小平方法近似。

cues.en: You can use gradient descent to find a solution in PyTorch, for example.
cues.zh: 也可以用梯度下降求解，例如透過 PyTorch。

cues.en: However, it is quite common to use the iterative linear approximation method using a library called
cues.zh: 不過，相當常見的做法是使用 Statsmodels 這個函式庫，

cues.en: Statsmodels, and when you use Statsmodels for logistic regression, it also provides a lot of useful statistical and diagnostic information.
cues.zh: 進行反覆線性近似。而用 Statsmodels 執行邏輯斯迴歸時，也會提供許多實用的統計與診斷資訊。

cues.en: Now, I still haven't told you yet why the logistic regression is based on log probabilities and not the probabilities themselves.
cues.zh: 我還沒回答，為什麼邏輯斯迴歸是以對數機率，而不是機率本身為基礎。

cues.en: The reason is actually the same reason why we use log probabilities when training models, which I explained earlier in the course.
cues.zh: 這其實與訓練模型時使用對數機率的理由相同，我在課程前面解釋過。

cues.en: And the answer is quite simple, actually.
cues.zh: 答案其實很簡單。

cues.en: Probabilities themselves are bound between 0 and 1, whereas log probabilities have a much larger range.
cues.zh: 機率本身受限於 0 到 1 之間，對數機率則有大得多的範圍。

cues.en: Furthermore, small probabilities that are close to zero can be numerically unstable and difficult to
cues.zh: 另外，接近零的小機率可能造成數值不穩定，也不容易

cues.en: work with, whereas log probabilities are just much easier.
cues.zh: 處理，而對數機率就容易處理多了。

cues.en: You end up with larger numbers, so they're easier to represent and calculate.
cues.zh: 數值會變大，因此更容易表示與計算。

cues.en: And that's basically what this text says over here.
cues.zh: 這基本上就是這裡這段文字的意思。

cues.en: There actually is a third reason as well, which is that to measure the conjunction of probabilities you need to multiply probabilities.
cues.zh: 其實還有第三個理由：要計算多個事件同時發生的機率，需要將機率相乘。

cues.en: But you can also equivalently add their logs.
cues.zh: 而這也等同於將它們的對數相加。

cues.en: I explained that in the section about quantitative evaluations.
cues.zh: 我在量化評估那一章說明過。

cues.en: Actually that third point is not directly relevant for us here with logistic regression, but it is just another general motivation for using log probabilities in machine learning.
cues.zh: 其實這第三點與這裡的邏輯斯迴歸沒有直接關係，但它是機器學習使用對數機率的另一個一般性理由。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So that is all of the background that I'm going to provide about logistic regression.
cues.zh: 以上就是我準備介紹的邏輯斯迴歸背景。
